title: A link to a path with a space: Read [the guide](<docs/my guide.md>).

clause.text: A link's destination may be in `<…>`, as on GitHub (CommonMark's link destinations): then it may hold spaces and parentheses, not a line break, `<` nor `>`

scenes.caption: In <…>, parentheses need no partner: "[the draft](<docs/my guide (draft.md>)" is a link too

clause.text: "Read [the guide](<docs/my guide.md>)." is "Read the guide.", "the guide" a link to `docs/my%20guide.md` next to the SKILL.md

scenes.caption: code-style's SKILL.md says "Read [the guide](<docs/my guide.md>).": "the guide" links docs/my%20guide.md next to it

clause.text: a `<` with no `>`, `[the guide](<docs/my guide.md)`, is text

scenes.caption: Now "[the guide](<docs/my guide.md)", with no closing >: it stays text, as on GitHub
